content:
The last solar eclipse before the year 2000 occurred on **August 11, 1999**. This was a total solar eclipse that was visible across Europe, the Middle East, and parts of Asia. It was particularly notable as it passed over many densely populated areas of Europe, including parts of the UK, France, Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Romania. The path of totality also crossed Turkey, Iran, and ended in India.

This eclipse was sometimes referred to as the "Eclipse of the Century" for the 20th century due to its visibility over so many populated areas in Europe.
